description: Pyth Price Candles. Calls only GET /v4/oracle/pyth/pricefeeds/{priceFeedAddress}/candles and returns that response. Solana API endpoint for fetching historical OHLC data from Pyth oracle price feeds. Get open, high, low, close prices for any Pyth price feed account.

eliminateCloseToOpenGaps.description: Eliminate gaps between candles by using previous close as next open. Default is true.

limit.description: Limit of the number of records to return

priceFeedAddress.description: Typed Solana public key identifier used across request parameters and response fields. Path parameter for /v4/oracle/pyth/pricefeeds/{priceFeedAddress}/candles.

resolution.description: Enumeration of supported resolution deprecated values for time range or aggregation configuration.

timeEnd.description: End time of the data to return (unix timestamp)

timeStart.description: Start time of the data to return (unix timestamp)

name: get-pyth-price-candles
title: Pyth Price Candles
